title: core.command.v1 ValidateTransaction payload
description: Check limits, KYC tier, fees and account state without moving money. Needs customer authorisation: mw-auth's transaction assertion (spec 18.7, D22) with the request's idempotencyKey, which the core needs to recompute the assertion's txnHash; except BULK_DISBURSE: the org authorised the whole batch by maker-checker in the org portal (ticket 34), so a bulk child carries none. No PIN travels to the core since ticket 72 (the PIN scheme M11 is gone).

idempotencyKey.description: The mw.txn.request.v1 idempotencyKey; part of the assertion's txnHash.
